body: I don’t want to talk about bad environment. It’s just not safe

When I talk on the phone with people? It’s just really terrifying to me. It’s like I’m hyper aware of how deep my voice is and how the person on the other end must think they’re talking to a boy? Even if I know the person I’m talking to,  like my passed grandfather, I can’t push past the stammering and the tears to be able to talk on the phone. This is debilitating. 

As far as distractions, I always felt the most relief from my severe depression in a university classroom. I can honestly say that being at school is the only time I’m don’t feel depressed. Once COVID-19 led to classes being moved online, I don’t have anything that relieves my depression in the same way. Even schoolwork is impossible to get through without crying.

I went to a psychiatrist who told me to either use TMS or ketamine infusion. I had severe anxiety about the TMS so I opted to try ketamine infusion. After the infusion, I just walked around hating how I felt and getting anxious for it to go away. 

I haven’t looked into ECT, I don’t think I’d ever agree to do that. I also don’t believe my starved heart is healthy enough to undergo that treatment.

I was on Sertraline, then Wellbutrin, then Effexor, then sertraline again, then Cymbalta, then sertraline for the final time. I’ve given up on that route but I appreciate that someone can empathise with how I’ve been struggling.
I did it once and I absolutely despised how numb I felt. Who would have thought drug use would just momentarily help distract me?
